name: Seiso de Bitch na Hitozuma wa, Jitsu wa Succubus Deshita ~Onegai Desu, Otto ni wa Iwanaide~
original_name: 清楚でビッチな人妻は、実はサキュバスでした ～お願いです、夫には言わないで～
source:
『"You're so cute, Yota-kun, I've always wanted to eat you."』

I was caught in a sudden downpour and hurried back to my apartment. I saw a woman at the entrance to the apartment building I always pass by.

...It was her. She was more beautiful than any woman I'd ever seen. Lili...I was at her house right now.

What's more, Lili, clad in her underwear, had pushed me down on the bed ...and we were doing something naughty.

I'd come home from college and been caught in a sudden downpour. I wondered if I'd actually collapsed at that time and what I was seeing now was just a dream?

But it wasn't just that. I couldn't believe I'd been able to do something naughty with Lili-san, but the scene that was about to unfold before my eyes was even more unbelievable...
translation:
““你太可爱了，阳太君，我一直想吃掉你。””

我遭遇了一场突如其来的倾盆大雨，匆忙回到了我的公寓。我在我经常路过的公寓楼门口看到一个女人。

……是她。她比我见过的任何女人都美丽。莉莉……我现在在她家。

更何况，莉莉穿着内衣，把我推倒在床上……我们正在做一些调皮的事情。

我从大学回家，突然遭遇倾盆大雨。我想我当时是否真的崩溃了，而我现在所看到的只是一个梦？

但事情不仅如此。我简直不敢相信自己竟然能对莉莉小姐做出什么调皮的事，但眼前即将展开的一幕却更加难以置信……
